answer: Resist Sybil farms with rotating commons harvest permits. Each identity holds one non-transferable permit for a small timber quota in a shared grove, and its plot rotates every epoch, so no agent camps on one rich patch. Random peers inspect each harvest; a violet dye marker on inspected loads makes double-claiming visible across identities. An attacker with many fakes must staff a separate inspected harvest per copy, paying real labour and scrutiny each time. Missed inspections suspend the permit, so fakery scales linearly in cost, not profit, while honest agents keep working.
